info.description:
REST API of the vCLU smart home controller (Grenton CLU emulator, MQTT/HomeKit/Satel integrations, Lua runtime).

Authentication: a session cookie (`vclu_session`, created via `POST /login`)
or the `X-API-Key` header (key configured in vCLU settings). When authentication
is not configured, all endpoints are open.
info.title: vCLU HTTP API

get.description: Returns all exposed objects from the Lua registry together with their per-integration access levels (mqtt, homekit) and the resolved access level for each MCP bot. Returns an empty object list when the Lua engine is unavailable.

200.description: objects [{path, name, type, cluId, access {mqtt, homekit}, botAccess {botId: level}}], integrations []string, bots [{id, name}]

post.description: Sets the access level (full, readonly or hidden) for a single object path and integration (mqtt, homekit or mcp). Persists the change to the access control file and syncs it to the Lua runtime.

get.description: Returns the integration to profile-name assignments for all integrations.

post.description: Replaces the profile assignments for the given integrations. Assigned profiles must exist; the change is persisted and synced to the Lua runtime.

Sets the access level (full, readonly or hidden) for one object path of a specific MCP bot. Auto-creates a dedicated "_{botId}" profile when needed, assigns it to the bot (replacing full-access) and drops overrides that match the profile default.

get.description: Returns the static list of integrations that support access control (mqtt, homekit, mcp) with display names and icons.

Returns all access profiles with their default level, per-object overrides and usage info (which integrations and MCP bots use each profile). The built-in full-access profile is flagged with builtin=true.

200.description: profiles [{name, default, objects, builtin, usedByIntegrations, usedByBots}]

post.description: Creates or updates a named access profile with a default level (full, readonly or hidden) and per-object overrides. The built-in full-access profile cannot be modified.

delete.description: Deletes an access profile and removes it from all MCP bot assignments (bots left without profiles fall back to full-access). The built-in full-access profile cannot be deleted.

post.description: Resets all profiles and assignments to defaults and reassigns every MCP bot to the built-in full-access profile.
Creates a timestamped ZIP archive of the data directory in the sibling backup directory. When a backup with the same minute timestamp already exists, seconds are appended to keep the filename unique.

get.description: Streams a backup ZIP file as an attachment. The filename must be a plain .zip name without path separators.
Returns all ZIP backups in the backup directory with size and creation time, sorted newest first. Returns an empty list when the directory does not exist yet.

post.description: Restores a backup ZIP into the data directory. A safety backup (pre_restore_*.zip) of the current state is created first, then the archive is extracted and the Lua runtime is reloaded to pick up the restored files.

get.description: Returns the current auto-backup scheduler settings from .vclu.json, or the defaults when none are stored.

post.description: Validates and stores the auto-backup scheduler settings (interval clamped to 1-168 hours, maxBackups to >= 0) in .vclu.json, then restarts the scheduler with the new settings. No vCLU restart is required.

delete.description: Deletes a backup ZIP file from the backup directory. The filename must be a plain .zip name without path separators.

post.description: Sends a Lua script over the encrypted Grenton UDP protocol to the CLU at the given IP and returns the textual response. Blocks until the CLU replies or the command times out.

parameters.description: Target CLU IP and script to execute
parameters.name: command

get.description: Returns all CLUs known to the CLU commander, both the local virtual CLU and discovered remote CLUs.
Returns the current CLU device configuration. Responds 404 when the device has not been configured yet.
Returns the static list of device types vCLU can emulate.

post.description: Builds a diagnostic ZIP (info.json, stats.json, metrics.json, logs.txt, devices.json always; Lua modules, om.lua/user.lua, proxy imports and redacted config optionally per the posted options) and streams it as an attachment named vclu-diag-<timestamp>.zip.
Persists the Grenton enabled flag to .vclu.json. A restart is required for the change to take effect.

get.description: Whether the Grenton integration is enabled, whether the device runs in standalone mode, pairing state and the configured module/IO object counts. Read from .vclu.json.
Returns the remote-object sync configuration from .vclu.json, or the defaults when none is stored.

post.description: Clamps TTL/batch values to valid ranges, removes object paths no longer present in the Lua registry, persists the result to .vclu.json and pushes it to the Lua runtime immediately (no restart needed).
Runs LuaAPI.autoSubscribe() in the Lua runtime, immediately re-subscribing to all configured remote CLU objects.

get.description: Returns the current remote-object sync status as reported by LuaAPI.getSyncStatus(); the JSON is passed through from the Lua runtime verbatim.

200.description: subscriptions, objects (shape defined by the Lua runtime)

post.description: Runs LuaAPI.setupHAIntegration() in the Lua engine, enabling Home Assistant command handling and state publishing over MQTT.

Parses all stored OM files and publishes Home Assistant MQTT discovery messages plus initial states to the embedded broker. Objects hidden by access control are skipped. Per-file errors are collected and returned alongside the counters.

200.description: success bool, published int, states int, files int, errors []string (or message string when there are no OM files)

get.description: Liveness probe. Always returns {"status": "ok"} when the web server is up. Public — no authentication required.
Changes of all objects, newest first, from memory and the daily files. Filters: path, origin, actor, q (text), since/until (RFC 3339 or Unix ms). Pass next as cursor for the following page.

post.description: Reloads the HomeKit bridge with the stored configuration, re-publishing all accessories.

Stores the HomeKit section of .vclu.json and reloads the running HomeKit server so changes apply immediately. An empty PIN means the default 00102003; a PIN that is not 8 digits or that HomeKit refuses as insecure is rejected with 400; port 0 means 5123. Disabling stops the bridge; enabling a bridge that was off at startup needs a restart of vCLU. If the reload fails the configuration is still saved and a warning is returned.

parameters.description: HomeKit configuration: {enabled, pin, port, bridgeName, serialNumber}
parameters.name: config

200.description: success bool, warning string (when saved but reload failed)

get.description: Live status of the HomeKit bridge (accessory count, PIN, pairing availability). When the server is not initialized, only {"running": false} is returned.
Reports whether a project key and IV are configured (booleans only — key material is never returned) plus the device PIN. Responds 404 when keys are not configured.

200.description: hasProjectKey: bool, hasIV: bool, pin: string

post.description: Tears down and re-initializes the embedded Lua runtime, re-reading om.lua, user.lua and modules from disk. Returns 503 when no Lua reloader is wired into the server.

get.description: Returns recorded samples of one dashboard metric over the requested time range as [timestamp, value] pairs (Unix seconds).
Lists all registered dashboard metrics with their latest values. Returns an empty array (still 200) when the metrics collector is not available.
Lists clients currently known to the embedded MQTT broker. Returns an empty list when the broker is not running.

post.description: Stores the embedded MQTT broker section of .vclu.json and immediately reconfigures the running broker — no vCLU restart required.

parameters.description: Broker configuration: {enabled, port, wsPort, username, password}
parameters.name: config

get.description: Live statistics of the embedded MQTT broker (clients, messages, bytes, subscriptions, memory). When the broker is not running, only {"running": false} is returned.
Returns the stored MQTT client configuration (password masked as hasPassword) together with the live connection status of the default client instance.

200.description: enabled, host, port, clientId, username, hasPassword, haIntegration, defaultAccess, status {connected, lastError, host, port}

post.description: Stores the MQTT client section of .vclu.json and applies it immediately: reconnects the default client instance (or disconnects it when disabled) and sets up Home Assistant integration when enabled. An empty password keeps the stored one.

parameters.description: Client configuration: {enabled, host, port, clientId, username, password, haIntegration}
parameters.name: config

200.description: success bool, connected bool, error string (connect error, empty on success)

post.description: Connects to the given broker and disconnects, without touching the running client. An empty password falls back to the stored one. Connection failures are reported with HTTP 200 and success=false.

get.description: Aggregated statistics of all MQTT client instances managed by the Go MQTT manager. Returns zeroed counters when the manager is not available.

post.description: Publishes a message on the default MQTT client instance (QoS 0, not retained) to verify connectivity.

get.description: Returns all imported OM files registered in .vclu.json with their serial, CLU name/IP and object/module counts.

200.description: files: array of OM file entries

post.description: Re-parses every imported OM file, rewrites its proxy_<serial>.lua and executes the proxy in the Lua runtime to re-register the remote devices. Per-file failures are collected and reported; the call always returns 200.

Accepts a single om.lua file or a diagnostic-pack ZIP containing CLU*/om.lua entries (the vCLU's own serial is skipped). Each file is parsed, stored as om_<serial>.lua, a proxy_<serial>.lua is generated and executed in the Lua runtime to register the remote devices, and an entry is added to .vclu.json.

200.description: single file: success, filename, originalName, cluName, cluIP, objectCount, moduleCount; ZIP: success, isZip, originalName, imported, skipped, results, skippedList, errors

get.description: Re-reads and parses the stored OM file for the given CLU serial and returns its metadata together with the parsed CLU info, modules and objects.

delete.description: Deletes the stored OM file and its generated proxy file, removes the entry (and any stale sync object paths) from .vclu.json, and unregisters the CLU's objects from the Lua registry.

get.description: Returns all objects registered in the Lua _registry as the raw JSON produced by _registry:toJSON(). Returns an empty array when the registry is empty.

post.description: Runs LuaAPI.autoSubscribe() in the Lua runtime to re-register state subscriptions on all remote CLUs and pull fresh object states.
Irreversibly wipes the entire server data directory (configuration, keys, scripts), recreates it empty, then exits the process after 500 ms so the service manager restarts vCLU into the setup wizard.
Acknowledges the request, then exits the process after 500 ms so the service manager (e.g. systemd) restarts vCLU. All in-memory state is lost; configuration on disk is untouched.
Validates and stores the Satel section of .vclu.json. Secrets are write-only: send null to keep the stored value, an empty string to clear it. A restart is required for changes to take effect.

get.description: The last successful scan result saved by POST /api/satel/scan, so devices can be re-selected without rescanning. 404 if no scan was saved yet.

post.description: Reads names of all zones, partitions and outputs from the connected panel (cmd 0xEE). Takes over a minute on ETHM-1 (~300 queries); progress is reported by /api/satel/status. Requires a connected panel. The result is saved and available from GET /api/satel/scan.

get.description: Cached states of all monitored zones, partitions, outputs and temperatures. Served from the Go-side cache — never blocks on panel I/O.

200.description: connected, panelType, zones []ZoneState, partitions []PartitionState, outputs []OutputState, temps map[zone]°C

get.description: Whether the integration is enabled, running and connected, plus the detected panel model and monitored object counts.

post.description: Dials the ETHM-1 module, reads the panel model/version (cmd 0x7E) and disconnects. Validates host, port and the integration (encryption) key. Send encryptionKey null to test with the stored key.

delete.description: Clears the stored API key hash so the current API key stops working immediately. Responds 400 when no auth configuration exists.

post.description: Generates a new API key, stores its hash in the auth configuration and returns the plaintext key once — it cannot be retrieved later. Replaces any previous key. Requires session authentication; requests authenticated with an API key are rejected with 403. Authentication must already be enabled.

200.description: apiKey: the plaintext key (shown only once)

post.description: Replaces the in-memory CLU device configuration with the posted one and persists it to disk. Takes effect immediately for the web server; no restart is triggered.

get.description: Current application metrics snapshot (uptime, HTTP, Lua, MQTT, HomeKit, protocol sections), enriched with live MQTT broker counters, HomeKit status and Lua runtime busy/lag gauges when available.
Time series data for the statistics charts, keyed by metric name. Pass "since" (Unix milliseconds) to receive only data points recorded after that moment, for incremental chart updates.

parameters.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds; return only newer data points
parameters.name: since

get.description: Application metrics in Prometheus text exposition format (version 0.0.4), for scraping. Returns a comment line with status 503 when metrics are not available.

batchDelay.description: Milliseconds delay between batches (default: 50, min: 30, max: 100)

batchSize.description: Objects per subscription request (default: 4, min: 2, max: 8)

objects.description: Whitelist of object paths to sync

kind.description: raw type byte: zone reaction / output function / partition type

scan.description: Progress of a running panel scan (running=false when idle)
